title: Bicep Curls - A
texts:
Complete 3 sets of 10 bicep curls, on each arm, with 45 seconds between each set, for a total of 6 sets.  Alternate arms on each set so you are resting for 90 seconds between sets on the same arm. This should mean you are nearly always working during this workout. 

Focus on slow and controlled movements. Use a load that is challenging but allows you to complete all of the reps and sets listed.
